title: PR attempt
premise: You are about to try a weight you have never lifted. The reel withholds whether you get it until the drop.

copy.hook: I have never lifted this before

shots.what: The loaded bar, tight, plates filling the frame. No face yet.
shots.subject: none
shots.shoot: Get the lens within a foot of the plate. Push in slowly on a gimbal — the number on the plate is the whole hook, so it must be readable in the first frame.

shots.what: You, standing over the bar, not moving. The stakes on your face.
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Camera at chest height, three metres back. Hold completely still for four seconds so the editor can cut anywhere inside it.

shots.what: Hands in chalk, clap, the dust hanging in the light
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Backlight the chalk if you can — dust against a dark background is the shot. One clap, two takes.

shots.what: You walking up to the bar, from behind or low
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Low angle, camera below waist height looking up. Walk past the lens rather than towards it — movement across frame is what makes a whip transition possible.

shots.what: Hands closing on the bar, knuckles white
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: As tight as the lens focuses. This is the last quiet shot before the drop, so keep it still.

shots.what: The breath in. Chest expanding, eyes down.
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Side on, tight on the ribcage and jaw. Two seconds of stillness — this is the shot that makes the drop land.

shots.what: The lift. Bar leaving the floor, the bend in it, the lockout.
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: 4K60 — this is the one shot you will want to slow down, and there is no clean slow motion without it. Shoot the whole lift from a locked-off tripod at 45 degrees. Do not pan; let the movement cross the frame.

shots.what: The bar dropped, you walking out of frame, or hands on knees
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Keep rolling after the lift. The three seconds nobody films are the three seconds that read as real.

shots.what: You looking straight down the lens, or the empty bar still rolling
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Hold four seconds. The text sits over this, so keep the middle of the frame uncluttered.
